label: G3
hypothesis: Risk-increasing resting quote: cancel when its price exceeds current valid bid-minus-one-cent target; retain existing reducing-quote policy; replacement requires confirmed closure.
data_scope: All accepted parents in completed 5-minute markets of first original G1 pilot and fixed read-only current London G2 capture; no filtering by realized win/loss. Missing data remains missing.

signals_require: own order identity and remaining quantity

economic_test_not_started.assignment: sha256('ULTRA-Q1|'+str(S)), first-byte low bit: 0 baseline G2, 1 G3
economic_test_not_started.shared_budget: existing remaining budget only; no reset or increase
economic_test_not_started.primary_metric: fee-net USD per assigned closed window, including zero fills; no assumed rebates
economic_test_not_started.minimum_claim_scope: 3 UTC days and at least 100 filled windows per arm; not a power guarantee
economic_test_not_started.acceptance: clustered lower CI > 0, ex-top3 difference > 0, worst terminal risk and unknown-order exposure not worse
economic_test_not_started.missing_boundary: local first fill notification is not execution time; unknown cancellation effect and counterfactual fills block simulated profit claims

london_capture.selection: Every complete BTC5m window in the fixed interval, independent of outcome

requirements: new decision-clock/order-state schema validated on real public feed without real orders
operator-only graceful source update and same-budget resume
engineering_gate.meaning: Ready only for an operator-initiated measurement experiment; no assumed PnL improvement.

operator_start.stop: normal STOP_G followed by account reconciliation
operator_start.budget: existing BUDGET_G and RUN_G bytes; no reset
operator_start.assignment: 0=G2, 1=G3 via predeclared first SHA256 byte low bit
operator_start.recording: g3_quote and g3_cancel_result in existing SDK telemetry, G3_ATAMA in bot log
